title: Manac\'a-1B-Instruct-2: Reproducible Safety Alignment for a Native Brazilian-Portuguese LLM. Negative DPO Results, a Controlled Composition Scan, and a Silent Failure Mode of the LLM Judge
abstract: arXiv:2610.20570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Brazilian Portuguese remains underserved by open-source language models, and the few that are safety-aligned rarely document what did not work or validate comparisons with statistical significance. We present Manac\'a-1B-Instruct-2, the second-generation post-training alignment of Manac\'a-1B (1.72B parameters, trained from scratch for PT-BR), with an SFT corpus of 291,223 examples. We document three DPO attempts, all negative, including a case where the training reward margin reaches 1.0 while free generation does not change at all, and show that safety came from a dedicated safety-SFT (LLM-jp AnswerCarefully style), refined over three iterations until closing the safety-helpfulness frontier. A controlled scan of the fraction of general data in the safety-SFT mix (10% to 60%) reveals a non-monotonic over-refusal curve with a knee point at 40-50%. translated_title: Manacá-1B-Instruct-2：面向原生巴西葡萄牙语大语言模型的可复现安全对齐——负面的DPO结果、受控的成分比例扫描，以及LLM评审的隐性失效模式
translated_abstract: 巴西葡萄牙语的开源语言模型仍然服务不足，而少数进行了安全对齐的模型也很少记录哪些方法行不通，或以统计显著性验证比较结果。我们提出Manacá-1B-Instruct-2，这是Manacá-1B（17.2亿参数，从零开始针对巴西葡萄牙语训练）的第二代后训练对齐版本，其SFT语料库包含291,223个样本。我们记录了三次DPO尝试，全部为负面结果，其中包括一次训练奖励边际达到1.0而自由生成结果却完全没有变化的情况，并表明安全性来自专门的安全SFT（LLM-jp AnswerCarefully风格），经过三次迭代优化直至封闭安全-有用性边界。对安全SFT数据混合中通用数据比例（10%至60%）的受控扫描揭示了非单调的过度拒绝曲线，其拐点位于40-50%。最终模型在相同项目上与四个外部巴西葡萄牙语模型进行比较，采用Wilson（置信区间）……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文为原生巴西葡萄牙语模型Manacá-1B-Instruct-2提供了可复现的安全对齐方案，记录了三次失败的DPO尝试（包括LLM评审奖励饱和而生成结果毫无变化的隐性失效模式），证明安全性来自专门的安全SFT，并通过受控扫描发现安全数据混合中通用数据比例的过度拒绝曲线呈非单调性，拐点在40-50%。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a reproducible safety alignment for the native Brazilian-Portuguese 1.72B model Manacá-1B-Instruct-2, documenting three negative DPO attempts (including a silent failure mode where LLM-judge reward margins saturate while generations remain unchanged), showing that safety comes from a dedicated safety-SFT, and revealing through a controlled composition scan a non-monotonic over-refusal curve with a knee point at 40-50% general data fraction.
